title: Sample-efficient learning with Dense Associative Memories
abstract: arXiv:2610.27384v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We analytically study the evolution of the energy function of Dense Associative Memories (DenseAMs) as they train on randomly sampled codewords of random expander low-density parity-check codes (a.k.a. solutions of random XORSAT problems). We identify two distinct regimes and a transition between them, reminiscent of grokking in neural networks. A regime of small training set size is where the model memorizes a few training examples but cannot discover the underlying rules of the entire codeword dictionary generative process. The opposite regime, corresponding to a larger training set size, is where the model has uncovered the sparse constraints that generated the entire data set after seeing only polynomially many patterns. translated_title: 基于稠密联想记忆的样本高效学习
translated_abstract: 我们解析地研究了稠密联想记忆在随机扩展器低密度奇偶校验码（又称随机XORSAT问题的解）的随机采样码字上进行训练时，其能量函数的演化过程。我们识别出两种截然不同的状态区间以及二者之间的转变，这让人联想到神经网络中的“顿悟”现象。在小训练集规模的状态下，模型只能记忆少量训练样本，却无法发现整个码字字典生成过程的底层规则。而在相反的状态下，对应于更大的训练集规模，模型在仅见过多项式数量级的模式之后，便已揭示出生成整个数据集的稀疏约束。我们还设计了一类新颖的采用阈值学习规则的稠密联想记忆，并证明任何程度的阈值化都能使模型执行简化的稀疏哈密顿量学习，从而指数级地降低……
tldr: 该论文解析地揭示了稠密联想记忆在训练中存在从单纯记忆样本到发现数据稀疏生成规则的“顿悟”式转变，并提出带阈值学习规则的新型稠密联想记忆，可执行简化的稀疏哈密顿量学习从而指数级降低样本复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper analytically identifies a grokking-like transition in Dense Associative Memories from memorizing examples to uncovering the sparse rules generating the data, and introduces a novel thresholding learning rule that enables simplified sparse Hamiltonian learning with exponentially reduced sample complexity.
